name: ecc
use_label: Skills, memory and security for agents
one_liner: Adds skills, memory and security rules to a coding agent harness.

text.why: Agent configuration tends to accumulate as a few skills here and a few rules there. ecc gathers skills, instincts, memory, security and research-first development into one harness setup and applies it the same way across Claude Code, Codex, Opencode and Cursor. It is written in JavaScript, published under MIT, and has a separate documentation site.
text.take: A large bundle of skills, memory and security rules, so pick a profile rather than switching everything on.
build: One shared baseline agent configuration for the team
A personal rule set that moves intact when you change tools

who.situation: gives the whole team one baseline agent setup
wants the same rules across Claude Code and Codex

start.text: Needs Node.js 18+, Git and Claude Code 2.1+
Or, in the Claude Code prompt:
Do not stack two install methods in one harness

caveat: Stacking two install methods in one harness duplicates skills and hooks
Native Windows is supported with open defects in some optional features
Hooks inject context each session (8,000 chars by default), raising token use

license.scope_text: Use, change and redistribute, commercially too. Keep the notice.

numbers.star_delta_unit: GitHub stars gained in the window, GH Archive events summed to as_of
numbers.method: Star total = the value last checked on GitHub (stars_checked_at) + increases observed via GH Archive since. The 24h · 7d · 30d gains are GH Archive hourly events summed to the reference time (as_of). No score of ours.
